title: zazzle commands component diagram
description: One file per command behind a common dispatcher. refs reuses find's parallel search; read-again reruns a command through the dispatcher or returns a stored output; clean's steps are also used by the MCP proxy and `zazzle run`; every command runs on the engine, walker, outliner and pool of the parent folder.

components.name: zazzle commands
components.responsibility: Runs one zazzle command line and shapes its output for the caller.

components.name: Dispatcher (mod.rs)
components.responsibility: Strips the global options, routes the command (with the aliases grep and cat), hands read-again to again.rs, answers status, help and version, refuses proxy and run with a pointer to their own processes, cuts output to the token budget and applies session ids, dedupe and replay records.

components.name: find (find.rs)
components.responsibility: Regex search over the walked files, on the pool, each file opened once into a reused per-thread buffer; grouped by file, ranked and capped; skips binary and large files.

components.name: read (read.rs)
components.responsibility: Numbered lines of files, ranges or one named symbol with a header (line count, sha), the middle elided beyond the token budget; optional line anchors; C# files as the indexer's terse view HTML and Razor files as markup.rs's terse view, CSS, SCSS, Sass and Less files as styles.rs's terse view, and Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, Rust, Go, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C, C++, Ruby, PHP, Scala, Perl, Lua, Elixir and shell files as terse.rs's terse view unless --source.

components.name: ls (ls.rs)
components.responsibility: A directory tree with recursive file counts and per-file line counts, to a depth and an entry cap; the summaries are computed on the pool.

components.name: outline (outline.rs)
components.responsibility: Symbols with line ranges for files, or for the outlinable files of a directory.

components.name: refs (refs.rs)
components.responsibility: Whole-word occurrences of a symbol, split into definitions and uses, each use with its enclosing symbol; matching files are loaded and outlined on the pool.

components.name: structure commands (structure.rs)
components.responsibility: overview, find-symbol, changed-since, git-log, git-blame and report-gap: arguments to the indexer tool of the same name for the working directory's git work tree, and its answer with paths relative to the working directory.

components.name: edit (edit.rs)
components.responsibility: Text replacement, line replacement, insertion and file creation, checked against the sha or anchors the caller read, confined to the working directory and written atomically.

components.name: clean (clean.rs)
components.responsibility: Shrinks text read from standard input: terminal escapes, redraws, whitespace, JSON, grep output, repeats, progress bars, blobs, long lines and a token budget, each removal marked; stores the answer with its input under an output id when the engine has an output store.

components.name: read-again (again.rs)
components.responsibility: Gives an answer back by its id: reruns a session response's request in its original working directory, or returns a stored clean, run or proxy output as it was shown, or with --full its uncut text as numbered lines for a range within a budget.

components.name: zazzled library
components.responsibility: The engine, walker, outliner, symbol finder, pool, indexer bridge, session table and helpers the commands run on.
